summary: Iteration 11 - E2E verified all 11 new features. Backend: 13/13 pytest cases PASS (test_iteration11.py). Verified: (1) DELETE /items with active loan -> 409 with 'aktive utlån bruker denne varen. Returner dem først.'; (2) DELETE /items with open order (status=bestilt) -> 409 with 'åpne bestillinger inneholder denne varen'; (3) DELETE /items clean -> 200 ok=true; (4) POST /items/{id}/delete-variant with active loan on variant M -> 409 'aktive utlån bruker variant M'; (5) POST /stock/manual-adjust empty reason -> 400 'Begrunnelse er påkrevd'; (6) 2-char reason -> 400; (7) Valid reason -> 200 with before/after/adjustment_id, item.total_stock persisted, stock_adjustments collection row created with diff/reason/user_email; (8) Clothing adjust with size M correctly updates variant.quantity (not total_stock directly); (9) GET /stock/adjustments returns list; (10) Non-existent variant -> 404; (11) GET /stock-counts/{id}/export returns valid xlsx with headers at row 6 (Linje-ID, Lokasjon, Varenavn, Størrelse, System, Talt antall, Diff, Notat), col A hidden, line_id in row 7+, counted empty for open count; (12) POST import updates counted_quantity by line_id lookup -> {ok, updated>=1, errors}; (13) Import on applied count -> 409; (14) POST /behovsskjema/{sid}/send WORKS now (returns 200) - sends Excel attachment via send_tenant_email - email proxy attachment issue from iter10 is RESOLVED. Frontend verified via playwright on prod URL: /app/behov route renders behov-page container, sidebar nav-behov testid present, new-behov-btn works. /app/varetelling has manual-adjust-btn + start-count-btn; dialog opens with item/qty/reason/confirm testids; clicking confirm without input shows toast 'Velg vare'. 'Siste manuelle justeringer' card renders. /app/utlan tab-returned exists; clicking shows returned-grouped container. /app/varemottak page contains 'Velg vare fra liste', 'Kategori', 'Hovedgruppe' labels. /app/utstyr table shows all 4 action labels (Opprett QR, Vis QR, Rediger, Slett) with text.

minor.issue: For klær-vare (is_clothing=true) when size is OMITTED, endpoint falls through to else-branch and sets item.total_stock directly instead of returning 400. Variants array becomes inconsistent with total_stock (sum of variant.quantity != total_stock). Spec said 'uten size returnerer feil' but current code accepts it. Low priority - UI dialog requires size for clothing items via adjust-size-select.

ui_bugs.issue: React 'Encountered two children with the same key' warnings on /app/varemottak - likely duplicate variant IDs in grouped tabs rendering. Not blocking but should fix map keys.

action_items: LOW: Fix React duplicate-key warning on /app/varemottak grouped lists (use composite key item_id+variant_id+size).
LOW: Consider rejecting POST /stock/manual-adjust when item.is_clothing/is_ball AND size is missing (currently silently sets total_stock, decoupling from variants).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 5063 lines - exceeds 700-line threshold. Strongly recommend splitting into modules: items.py, loans.py, stock_audit.py, email.py, orders.py, behovsskjema.py, auth.py, admin.py.
Stock manual-adjust for clothing without size: silent fall-through to total_stock update desynchronizes with sizes array. Should enforce size requirement for variant-bearing items.
Delete-item validation checks loans + purchase_orders but NOT behovsskjema line references. If a behovsskjema has a line referencing item_id, deletion still succeeds and may leave dangling refs.

Behovsskjema send endpoint doesn't validate that _build_needs_template_bytes produces non-empty content - if team has no needs lines, empty template is still sent. Consider either generating a blank-but-valid template (current behavior) or warning user.

stock-count export: line_id column A is marked hidden=True but ws cell at row 7 col 1 still contains the ID. Good design. However import blindly uses row[0] as line_id - if a user accidentally unhides and edits col A, could cause silent misassignment. Consider adding a hidden sanity hash column or signed line_ids.

To test clothing variant adjust, size must be provided; adjust-size-select appears after selecting a clothing item.
rca of the issue: N/A - no critical bugs. The clothing-without-size silent total_stock update is a minor validation gap - the FE dialog prevents this but a direct API caller could cause data drift. Recommend adding explicit 400 check: `if (item.is_clothing or item.is_ball) and not data.size: raise HTTPException(400, 'Størrelse er påkrevd for klær/ball')`.
